_comment: Accepted Semgrep findings (contrib/semgrep/README.md, 'Accepting a finding'). findings: fingerprint -> {rule, path, reason, by, date}. rule_paths: [{rule (glob), paths (globs), reason, by, date}]. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check.

e8d06a1f65f661c2.reason: The JSON-RPC response body from the pool's own ycashd (the configured --rpc URL, not a miner). ureq 3's Body::read_to_string is bounded: it applies .limit(MAX_BODY_SIZE), 10 MB (ureq-3.4.2 src/body/mod.rs, read_to_string), and errors beyond it.

rule_paths.reason: Regtest getblocktemplate vectors: the flagged values are block/tree hashes (previousblockhash, lightclientroothash, ...), public chain data, not secrets (checked 2026-10-23). A secret anywhere else is still reported.
The regtest harness's scratch directory for its own throwaway nodes (YOLO_REGTEST_SCRATCH overrides it; CI sets it to RUNNER_TEMP). Test-only, never in the pool binary.
